title: Mount pin carrier
instruction: The robot picks the pin carrier from the rack and hands it to the worker. The worker aligns and mounts it in the first fixture.

title: Mount central input shaft
instruction: The robot supplies the central spur/input shaft. The worker aligns and mounts it in the pin carrier.

title: Mount planet gear 1
instruction: The robot supplies the first planet gear. The worker aligns it with its assigned carrier pin and seats it at the assembly target.

title: Mount planet gear 2
instruction: The robot supplies the second planet gear. The worker mounts it on its assigned carrier pin while the first gear remains installed.

title: Mount planet gear 3
instruction: The robot supplies the third planet gear. The worker mounts it on the remaining assigned carrier pin.

title: Mount output shaft/carrier
instruction: The robot supplies the output shaft/carrier. The worker mounts it to complete the internal subassembly.

title: Seat housing
instruction: The robot picks the housing from the rack and seats it in the second fixture.

title: Insert internal assembly
instruction: After all internal components and the housing are installed, the robot grips the internal assembly, aligns it with the housing, and inserts it.

title: Install lid
instruction: The robot picks the lid, aligns it with the housing, and seats it at the lid target.

title: Install screw 1
instruction: The robot supplies screw 1. The worker aligns, threads, and visually tightens it. The simulated cross-pattern order is 1, 3, 2, 4.

title: Install screw 3
instruction: The robot supplies screw 3. The worker installs it opposite screw 1, continuing the simulated cross pattern.

title: Install screw 2
instruction: The robot supplies screw 2. The worker aligns, threads, and visually tightens it at its target.

title: Install screw 4
instruction: The robot supplies screw 4. The worker installs the final screw, completing the simulated twelve-part assembly.
